result.stdout:
USAGE:
    nicastack [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    nicastack list
    nicastack help
    nicastack create Billing --template ardalis-full
    nicastack create Billing --template ardalis-minimal --output ./sandbox 
--git-init
    nicastack wizard
    nicastack doctor
    nicastack version

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    list             List available templates               
    help             Show general CLI help                  
    create <name>    Generate a project from a template     
    wizard           Open the interactive wizard            
    doctor           Check whether your environment is ready
    version          Show the CLI and runtime version
